'''Rice plants''' are an [[aboveground]] [[crop]]. They can either be [[milling|milled]] into [[flour|rice flour]] or [[brewing|brewed]] into [[alcohol|rice beer]].

Some [[dwarves]] [[Preferences|like]] rice plants for their ''grain''.
